characters.lead: Veeronica is a FORSAKEN-original Survivalist Survivor, available for 750 Player Points. She is the eleventh Survivor introduced and was released in the Chapter 2: Strangers from the Past update on October 31, 2025, alongside Guest 666. Veeronica specializes in mobility and self-defense, using a skateboard and tricks to create distance from the Killer and even knock them back on impact. She also carries rechargeable batteries capable of restoring her own health, but cannot use any other healing items whether the batteries are active or not.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/veeronica-title.webp

abilities.name: METAL FRAME
abilities.desc:
Veeronica has a passive battery at the top right of her screen. Because she is a robot, she is prevented from using any healing items — including Medkits, Elliot's **Pizza**, or Builderman's **Dispensers**. Her rechargeable batteries are her only source of healing and can be activated through her **Activate Battery** ability. The effects are as follows:
•The Battery heals up to 50 HP at 100% battery charge.
•Starts each round with 30% charge.
•Completing a generator puzzle restores 8% battery per puzzle.

**Undocumented:**

•Because the Battery value does not display decimals, the number shown for Veeronica's Battery can sometimes appear slightly inaccurate.
••For example, if she were to take exactly 8.6 damage at full health while at 100% Battery, she would lose 17.2% Battery, leaving her at 82.8% charge, which is displayed as 83%.
••For another example, if Veeronica's Battery is displayed as 50% and she completes a generator puzzle that grants 8% Battery, the result may be shown as 57% instead of 58%. However, if she completes the entire generator herself—or complete three additional generator puzzles—the Battery will display as 82%.
•Fake Generators don't restore Battery.
•Hallucinations of Elliot's **Pizza**, or Builderman's **Dispensers** do not affect her.
•Veeronica cannot place Graffiti on a hallucination of a Dispenser.
•**Metal Frame** is effective in private servers and cannot be disabled.
•Veeronica can use the “Fake Medkit” item in private servers.
abilities.quote: roger roger

abilities.name: VANDALISM
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can equip or unequip her spray paint, allowing her to spray Graffiti onto a wall by left clicking and holding. The effects are as follows:
•Takes 5 seconds to complete one piece of Graffiti.
•Each Graffiti creates a rectangular Graffiti Zone with a hitbox of 12×30×12 studs that phases through walls and enables the use of **Sk8** when inside of it, visible only to Veeronica.
•Can place up to 3 pieces of Graffiti at once.
•Graffiti cannot be placed within spray range (4×4×7) of each other unless Veeronica is behind a wall.
•There's a 1/25000 chance that a rare Graffiti, unlisted among the default Graffitis, may appear.

**Graffiti Erasure:**

•Veeronica can erase her own Graffiti by holding Spacebar near it with the spray can equipped.
•Graffitis have an erase range of 4×7×1 for Killers attack hitboxes.
••However, Veeronica can erase her own Graffiti as long as she is within 4×4×7 studs of the 4×7×1 Graffiti hitbox.
•Graffitis have 5 health and can be erased by the Killer.
•If any Graffiti is erased without Veeronica doing it herself, **Vandalism** goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.

**Undocumented:**

•Graffiti can't just be placed on walls and structures. They can be placed on basically any surface that isn't another Graffiti, the Killer, or a Survivor. This includes: Invisible Barriers, Killer-Only Doors, Builderman's **Constructions**, Taph's **Subspace Tripmine**, Elliot's **Pizza**, 007n7's **Clone**, John Doe's **Corrupt Energy**, c00lkidd and 1x1x1x1's **Minions**, and Items.
••If a surface has Graffiti on it, it'll become erased and go on cooldown if said surface no longer exists. (I.E. Placing Graffiti on Taph's **Subspace Tripmine**, and then the trap explodes.)
••Graffiti does not automatically erase if the surface moves away from the graffiti(I.E. Placing Graffiti on John Doe's Corrupt Energy, and then the spikes sink into the ground for a bit before despawning.)
•If Veeronica is not facing a surface directly enough (around 50°), Graffiti will not be placed.
• On-hit effects can trigger by hitting Graffiti, though this currently only applies to John Doe's **Corrupt Energy**.
• Graffiti is placed directly in front of Veeronica, from head height and centered from the torso.
• Erased Graffiti plays a sound and shows an icon where it was placed.
• If the Killer destroys Graffiti, other pieces of Graffiti within 4.5 studs will be destroyed.
• Graffiti zones are highlighted to the Killer when Veeronica uses her **Sk8** ability.
• Being in a graffiti zone for an estimate of 0.5s will cause Veeronica's antennas to light up.
• Veeronica has to be standing on the ground for the spray can to work.
• Veeronica cannot place graffiti on Noli's Fake Generators.
abilities.quote: HEY! *whistle*

abilities.name: SK8
abilities.cd: 0.5s(upon activation; can still trick but cannot recast)
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can only use **Sk8** while standing inside a Graffiti Zone. The effects are as follows:
•Moves at 1.15x (29.9 studs per second) running speed while skating.
•**Consumes 1.35x** (13.5 per second) **more stamina** than regular sprinting.
•Has very limited turning control while skating.

**Crashing and Penalties:**

•Crashing into a wall or the Killer with **Mobile** active deals 5 self-damage.
•Applies ⟦Slowness|4⟧ for 2.5 seconds upon crashing.

**Cancellation:**

•**Sk8** goes on a 5 second cooldown.
•Veeronica can cancel skating at any time by recasting the ability, this bypasses the ⟦Helpless|⟧ effect.
•If Veeronica's stamina runs out, **Sk8** ends immediately with no extended exhaustion, despite her increased movement speed while skating.
•When activating **Sk8**, the Graffiti piece she used becomes highlighted within 25 studs for 2 seconds (visible to both Veeronica and the Killer)

**Undocumented:**

•Veeronica begins skating in the direction the camera is facing.
•While using **SK8**, Veeronica does not lose speed when falling and immediately moves at 1.15× her running speed without an acceleration window.
•**Sk8** retains the same target when yaw is stable, but camera pitch affects raycast hit precision, which can determine whether the system resolves a trick/crash cleanly or cancels **Sk8**.
••Veeronica can also get kicked out of **Sk8** by being slowed down too heavily, such as getting hit by 1x1x1x1's Entanglement and sometimes Noli's Nova.
•Veeronica cannot emote or use items while skating.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: SK8 - TRICK
abilities.desc:
When approaching a collidable surface (entering a 13-stud radius when going toward it, or a 3-stud radius when her side is facing it), Veeronica will glow and can perform a **Trick** by pressing Spacebar / X / Sprint (PC / Controller / Mobile) to rebound off it. Veeronica stays in the air for 1 second. The effects are as follows:
•The 1.15x speed boost while skating is increased to a 1.42x boost while in the air.
•Veeronica receives crash immunity for ~0.75s.
•Veeronica restores 4 Stamina.
•Performing 3 **Tricks** in a row charges Veeronica's Battery by 5%.
•Attempting a **Trick** on nothing will make Veeronica glow red while still putting **Trick** on cooldown.

**Undocumented:**

•Veeronica's maximum jump height from performing a **Trick** is 10 studs.
•Interacting with an object will override the **Trick** input.
•**Sk8** does not account for certain collidable surfaces; attempting to skate on them will either allow Veeronica to pass through (common with smaller-than-normal objects) or cause Veeronica to be kicked out of **Sk8**.
••The cooldown on activating **Sk8** only applies to manual reverts; this action will end **Sk8** immediately.
•Holding the Spacebar / X / Sprint (PC / Controller / Mobile) while **Trick** is on cooldown will instantly activate **Trick** once again as soon as it's off cooldown, buffering **Trick**.
abilities.quote: NO WAY....

abilities.name: BROADCAST - PHASE
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

•Upon colliding with a Killer:
••Gain ⟦Resistance|II⟧ for 3 seconds and ⟦Speed|II⟧ (35.88 studs per second) for 1.5 seconds.
••**Phase** through the Killer.
••Phasing charges Veeronica's Battery by 15%. (can only be used once per **Sk8**)

**Undocumented:**

•**Phase**'s speed boost overrides other speed boosts (such as Bloxy Cola).
•**Phase**'s mechanic only triggers with Killer, not Minions.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: BROADCAST - BUMPER
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

•Upon crashing into a Killer:
••Knock the Killer back.
••Charge Veeronica's Battery by 15%.
••Does not deal self-damage or apply ⟦Slowness|⟧.
•**Sk8** ends immediately if she crashes into the Killer.
•If the Killer has been hit by a **Bumper** in the last 20s, knockback will not occur.
••A meter appears above Veeronica's **Broadcast** ability when **Bumper** is selected to indicate its cooldown. If no meter is shown, **Bumper** is not on cooldown.

**Undocumented:**

•**Bumper** deals 5 damage when colliding with the Killer.
•Knockback is ping-dependent, applying massive, minor, or no knockback based on the Killer's connection.
•**Bumper**'s mechanic only triggers with Killers, not Minions.
•Upon performing a **Trick**, the Killer is immune to **Bumper** knockback for 1 second (if this is not intended, this may be caused by the crash immunity granted upon performing a **Trick**).
•**Bumper**'s hitbox is dependent on the angle Veeronica is skating:
••Skating upwards will knock the Killer high up into the air.
••Skating downwards will push the Killer down, causing little to no knockback.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: BROADCAST - MOBILE
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

•**Trick's** increased turn control lasts 2 seconds after landing.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: ACTIVATE BATTERY
abilities.desc:
Veeronica begins slowly healing herself using her Battery. Healing stops if:
•Maximum health is reached.
•Battery charge runs out.
•Veeronica takes any damage (including Status Effects that deal damage over-time).

**Undocumented:**

•Healing occurs at 1 HP per second.
•1 hp equals 2% of the battery
•If Veeronica has at least 1% charge, Battery can still be activated, restoring 1 HP even though the required threshold is not met.
•While the Battery is in use, gaining energy from other sources does not increase its charge.
•After ⟦Regeneration|⟧ ends, there is a very brief moment before Battery can be gained again.
•Damage only counts if it's health being lost, losing only overhealth will not cancel the healing as long as no actual health is lost.
•**Activate Battery**'s ⟦Regeneration|⟧ starts instantly after the ability is used.

characters.lead: Guest 1337 is a Sentinel Survivor available for purchase for 500 Player Points. Metaphorically known as the shield of the Survivors, his kit is one of the most challenging to use. Players have to anticipate the Killer's incoming attack and block it, often on a split-second reaction and some luck, then counter with a punch that stuns them. Guest 1337 can also charge at the Killer to knock them back, which helps extend distance.

abilities.name: MADE TO LAST
abilities.desc: Guest 1337 gains an extra 10HP (was 15) as a Survivor.
abilities.quote: "Never show fear, no matter the odds." - Guest 1337

abilities.name: SELF SACRIFICE
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 has hit priority over other entities, such as survivors and structures. This increases the consistency of Guest 1337's defensive abilities and allows him to tank hits for teammates. It's worth noting that this passive becomes completely obsolete against piercing attacks, since they can hit multiple Survivors as long as they are within the hitbox.

**This mechanic has three tiers:**
•**Tier 1**:
••Standard priority.
••The entity closest to the Killer's hitbox is damaged.
•**Tier 2**:
••Guest 1337's default passive.
••If multiple players are stacked in the same position, he will always be hit.
••If multiple Guest 1337s are stacked, only one of them takes damage.
•**Tier 3**:
••Active only during Guest 1337's Block.
••Overrides Tier 1 and Tier 2.
••If multiple Guest 1337s are blocking in the same spot, only one of them takes damage.
abilities.quote: "You'll have to get through me first." - Guest 1337

abilities.name: BLOCK
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 braces for an incoming attack, expanding his collision hitbox.
•Applies ⟦Resistance|V⟧ for 1 second.
•Movement speed is reduced by 50% for 1.75s.
•Only fully blocks Main Abilities (referred to as **Basic Attacks (M1s or M1 extensions)**), but is able to negate most ability damage.

**Upon successfully blocking a Basic Attack:**
•⟦Resistance|V⟧ is removed, and the damage is fully negated.
•Grants 10 stacking ⟦Overheal|⟧ that does not naturally decay, up to a maximum of 30.
•Guest 1337's movement speed is restored and they gain ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 2s.
•The Killer's movement speed is reduced by 30% for 1 second.
•Fully resets the cooldown of Guest 1337's **Punch**.

**If blocking an ability that is not a Basic Attack:**
•**Block** immediately breaks and restores normal movement speed. A special animation is played when this happens.
•Guest 1337 is hit normally, but the damage is reduced by 40%.
•Guest 1337 gains ⟦Resistance|II⟧ for 3s.

**Undocumented:**
•Abilities will be locked out (non-visibly) for about 2s if Guest 1337 fails to **Block** any attack.
•Guest 1337 gains ⟦Strength I|⟧ for 5s upon a successful block.
•Guest 1337 cannot block more than one attack. This can be seen by blocking a killer's Basic Attack, then getting struck by an already-existing stray projectile.
•Despite having a Main Ability bind, Nosferatu's **Dive** does not count as a Basic Attack.
abilities.quote: "Stay strong, friend. I got your back." - Guest 1337

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 lets out a battle cry and dashes forward in a shoulder-bash pose for 1.5s, having his stamina gain paused for the duration.

**If** Guest 1337 **collides with the Killer:**
•The Killer takes 5 damage and is knocked back depending on how long Guest 1337 charged, with a minimum of 6 studs and up to a maximum of 11 studs, charging over the course of 0.5s.
•Guest 1337 is inflicted with ⟦Resistance|III⟧ for 0.55s.

**If** Guest 1337 **does not collide with the Killer:**
•Guest 1337 receives ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for a duration equal to ( 3 × stud distance to nearest Killer) ÷ 13.
•**Charge** ends automatically if Guest 1337 crashes into a wall or falls off a high ledge.

•The knockback value of **Charge** is reduced by 10% for every additional Guest 1337 currently alive.

**Undocumented:**
•Guest 1337 can "sprint" during **Charge**. However, this will only affect the stamina regeneration delay.
•Abilities are locked during and after **Charge** ends in any way for 1s. Disabling ability cooldowns via the Command Panel doesn't bypass this.
•The maximum ⟦Slowness|II⟧ duration Guest 1337 can get when missing a **Charge** is 15s, while the minimum is 3s. However, if Guest 1337 is near the killer when Charge ends, no penalty is applied.
•If Guest 1337 charges into a Killer who has already been charged within the past 20s, **Charge**’s effects will be nullified.
••A meter above Guest 1337's **Charge** ability to indicate its global cooldown. If no meter is shown, **Charge** is not on "cooldown".
•**Charge** can be manually canceled if the user starts repairing a Generator at the correct moment.
abilities.quote: "Incoming! Look out!" - Guest 1337

abilities.name: PUNCH
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 pulls back his right fist before immediately swinging it forward, with varying results as documented below.

**Regular Punch**

If Guest 1337 uses the ability normally:
•Can only connect with one target and has a windup of 0.6s. **Does not stun**.
•The Killer is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ and ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 2s on hit, lowered by 0.35s for every Guest 1337 currently alive.
•Deals 25 damage on hit.
•Knocks the Killer back by 7 studs on hit.

**Parry Punch**

If Guest 1337 uses the ability immediately after successfully blocking a Basic Attack:
•The hitbox pierces, and Guest 1337 receives ⟦Resistance|II⟧ during the reduced windup of 0.4s.
••The Killer takes 42 damage (actually 35) and is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2s on hit.
•Knocks the Killer back by 13 studs on hit.

**Undocumented:**
•**Punch**'s icon turns yellow upon a successful Basic Attack **Block** to signify Guest 1337 is able to do a Parry **Punch**.
••Erroneously, this happens even if Guest 1337 blocks an ability attack.
•Parry **Punch**'s lunge stops prematurely if Guest 1337 connects with a target.
• **Punch** cannot interrupt active Killer abilities, and the knockback values of **Punch** are reduced by 10% for every additional Guest 1337 currently alive.

characters.caption: Shadows die twice.
characters.description: A fragile cultist that holds a terrible secret. Bearing nothing other than a sleek dagger and a manic smile, they're able to earn a second life through risk and sacrifice.
characters.lead: Two Time is a FORSAKEN-original Sentinel and Survivalist Survivor, available for purchase at 500 Player Points. A spiritual-based survivor. they can carve a Spawn Point into the ground and charge their passive Oblation bar using their dagger. The dagger can stab the Killer at any angle, with backstabs applying stronger effects and even stronger effects with **Crouch** backstab. All successful stabs contributes to filling the bar. They can either use this bar to heal themselves near the Spawn Point via **Pray**, or save it for a second life. Once full, if Two Time's health reaches 0, they respawn at their planted point with a second life, hence the name "Two Time". If the Oblation Bar isn't full, they die normally.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/two-time-title.webp

abilities.name: OBLATION
abilities.desc:
Two Time builds **Oblation** by dealing damage to the Killer, filling a meter that appears on the right side of the screen whenever damage is dealt. This meter determines whether they can respawn after death. Once full, dying will trigger a **second life** at their placed Ritual, but with reduced health and durability.

**Oblation Gain:**

•Front stab: +20%
•Backstab: +40%

**Second Life Activation:**

•If the **Oblation** bar is filled, Two Time will enter their second life upon taking lethal damage.
•Two Time is the last Survivor, but they will not respawn at their placed Ritual.

**Second Life Effects:**

•Respawns with 50 HP, which is 62.5% of their base health (80).
•Restores 40% Stamina.
•Removes all status effects.
•Gains 2 seconds of invincibility.
•Applies ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 6 seconds.
•Applies ⟦Vulnerable|V⟧ for 12 seconds.

**Limitations:**

•Requires a placed Ritual to activate.
•Without a Ritual, a full bar will not prevent death.

**Undocumented:**

•Adds 20 seconds to the round timer upon triggering a second life, excluding Last Man Standing (LMS) respawns.
•Due to 2 seconds of invincibility, ⟦Vulnerable|5⟧ technically lasts 10 seconds.
abilities.quote: "You both shall set out on the grand step to rebirth." - ██████

abilities.name: SACRIFICIAL DAGGER
abilities.desc:
Two Time pulls out the **Ghostfire Dagger**, striking the Killer for damage and sustaining themselves. The outcome depends on positioning, rewarding precise backstabs with stronger effects.

**Activation:**

•0.3s windup.
•Grants ⟦Resistance|1⟧ for 0.7.

**On Hit:**

•**Front stab:**
••Deals 10 damage.
••Applies ⟦Slowness|II⟧ and ⟦Helpless|⟧ to the Killer for 1 second.
•**Backstab:**
••Deals 20 damage.
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2s.

**Stabbing while Crouched:**

•Transforms into a faster forward lunge that lunges you about **22 studs** with increased endlag and increase the Dagger stun duration ( 2s -> 3.5s )

**Limitations:**

•Landing a stab on a minion or a stun immune Killer does not grant Oblation.

**Undocumented:**

•Named **Dagger** in-game.
•Cannot sprint during use.
•Dagger hitbox reaches up to **5 studs**
abilities.quote: "Lookie, █████-they gave us this cool knife!" - Two Time

abilities.name: CROUCH
abilities.desc:
Two Time enters a stealth state by **crouching** with their Ghostfire Dagger in hand, silencing their footsteps and preparing for an ambush.

**Effects while Crouched:**

•Applies ⟦Undetectable|⟧.
•Applies ⟦Invisibility|III⟧.
•Silences footsteps.
•**Crouching** and its effects last up to 15 seconds or until manually uncrouched
•Two Time's aura is revealed to other Survivors within 100 studs.
•Two Time will gradually gain speed while running towards the Killer, with this speed capping out on 40% over 4s. This speed boost is immediately lost if Two Time exits Crouch, takes damage, or stops running towards the Killer.

**If** Two Time **manually uncrouches:**

•Removes ⟦Undetectable|⟧ and ⟦Invisibility|III⟧.
•If within 30 studs of the Killer, gains ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 1 second.

**Undocumented:**

•While **crouched**, Two Time's walk speed is reduced to 10 and their run speed is reduced to 20.
•For some odd reason, **Crouch** does not show it's cooldown when you are currently undergoing it's effects despite it ticking down.
•For some odd reason, if Two Time **crouches** before respawning during Last Man Standing (LMS), they remain **crouched** after respawning and are still highlighted.
abilities.quote: "Quiet, Two Time! They're not supposed to see us in here, hehe!" - █████

abilities.name: PRAY
abilities.desc:
Two Time will kneel near their RITUAL and begin praying while this ability is held.

•Letting go of the ability will stop PRAYING.
•While PRAYING, Two Time will rapidly exchange OBLATION progress for HP.
•Two Time will gain 1 HP for every 2% OBLATION progress spent, up to 50 HP at 100% OBLATION progress.
•If Two Time is not near their RITUAL when attempting to use this ability, the location of their RITUAL will be revealed to them for 4s.
•Two Time is unable to use this ability if they do not have a RITUAL.
•Two Time Gets their OBLATION Revealed to themselves while using this ability.
abilities.quote: "May spawn bless us today!" - █████''

abilities.name: RITUAL
abilities.desc:
Two Time carves a **Ritual** into the ground, marking a respawn point that enables their second life through Oblation.

**Core Effects:**

•Dying with a full Oblation bar instantly teleports Two Time to the **Ritual**.
•Can only be placed and used once per round.

**Last Man Standing (LMS) Bonus:**

•Two Time automatically enters their second life, even if their Oblation bar is not full.
•Maximum HP is increased to 110.
•Heals up to 50 HP.
•Does not receive the ⟦Vulnerable|5⟧ penalty.
•Will not be teleported to their placed **Ritual**.
•Any buffs gained are reduced based on how much **Oblation** is missing.

**Undocumented:**

•Windup: ~4s
•**Ritual** visuals intensify with higher Oblation.
•Without a planted **Ritual**, even a full Oblation bar will not trigger a respawn.

•Triggers cooldown.

**Successful Shot (50% → 70% → 90%):**

•Deals 50 damage.
•Stuns the Killer within 90 studs for 1–4 seconds (linearly decreasing with distance).

**Charge Scaling:**

•Each additional charge grants:
••+20% success chance
••-10% explosion chance
••-10% misfire chance
•Using **One Shot** consumes all charges from every ability.

abilities.name: REROLL
abilities.desc:
Chance rerolls his Max Health to a random value between 55–120.

**Charge Multipliers:**

•1 charge → no bonus
•2 charges → Rolled HP is increased by +5% (0.05)
•3 charges → Rolled HP is increased by +10% (0.10)

**Formulas:**

•**New Max HP** = Rolled HP (55–120) × (1 + charge multiplier) (0.05 or 0.10)
•**New Current HP** = New Max HP × (old Current HP/old Max HP)
**Formula Example:**

•**Variables:**
••**90** Rolled HP; randomly rolled between 55–120
••**0.10** (10%); 3 charges
••**64/79**; old Current HP (64)/old Max HP (79)

•**Calculation:**
••90 × (1 + 0.10) = **99 New Max HP**
••99 × (64/79) = **~80.2 New Current HP**
••**Result**: 80/99 (80.2 is rounded to 80)
•••Both 64/79 and 80/99 maintain the ~81% ratio

**Caveats:**

•**Reroll** starts off with 0 charges and has a cap of 3 charges.
•Chance's new maximum HP cannot exceed 130 HP.
•Using **Reroll** removes all charges from other abilities.

**Undocumented:**
•In the simplest explanation, without the math, **Reroll** either increases or decreases your current and maximum HP.
•**Reroll** does not restore HP directly. Instead, it scales both Max HP and Current HP by the same amount, keeping the remaining HP percentage unchanged. For example, 80/90 HP (~89%) becomes 99/111 HP (~89%) after **Reroll**.
•Since Chance's Max HP cannot exceed 130, the 3-charge bonus (10%) becomes less effective at high rolls. At the maximum roll of 120, the bonus would normally give 132 HP, but it is capped at 130. 120 × 1.10 = 132 → capped to 130.
••This means the actual gain is +10 HP instead of +12 HP. Because part of the multiplier is lost to the cap, the effective increase is reduced to about 8.33% at this upper limit (120 + 8.33% = 130).

characters.lead: Jane Doe is a Sentinel and Support Survivor and the 12th Survivor added to FORSAKEN, introduced in Update 4.0.0 on March 18, 2026. Unlike other survivors, she cannot be unlocked using Player Points and must instead be obtained through her quest. She excels in sustainability and self-defense, possessing a built-in damage reduction shield separate from her main health that is strengthened by landing abilities. She can throw an explosive crystal to build up stun potential, strike the Killer with her hatchet to slow or stun it, and use that same crystal to support teammates by giving brief resistance.

abilities.name: SHATTERPOINT
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe possesses a unique health system known as **Shatterpoint HP**, which cannot be healed by outside sources but benefits from 40% damage reduction.

**Base Stats:**

•Spawns with 20 **Shatterpoint HP**.
••Starter shatterpoints are reduced by 10% for every extra Jane alive.
•Can restore up to a maximum of 30 **Shatterpoint HP** through her abilities.

**Shatterpoint Mechanics:**

•**Shatterpoint HP** is restored by successfully landing abilities.
•If Jane Doe is reduced to 0 **Shatterpoint HP**, she cannot regenerate it for 40 seconds.

**Scaling Penalty:**

•For each additional Jane Doe alive, all **Shatterpoint HP** gained from abilities is reduced by 10%.

**Undocumented:**

•When all **Shatterpoint HP** is lost, after 40 seconds you automatically regenerate 5 **Shatterpoint HP**, regardless of stacking penalties.
•**Shatterpoint HP** prevents being kicked off items and generators when taking damage.
•While Status Effects that deal damage over-time do not pierce through **Shatterpoint HP**, they still bypass the 40% damage reduction that **Shatterpoint HP** normally provides. Damage-over-time effects simply calculate their damage without applying her reduction. Because overheal values do not display decimals, this can cause Jane Doe's **Shatterpoint HP** to appear slightly inaccurate.
••For example, if she is hit by c00lkidd's **Walkspeed Override** while at maximum **Shatterpoint HP**, she will lose 28.2 **Shatterpoint HP**, which appears in-game as having 2 **Shatterpoint HP** remaining despite her technically only having 1.8 **Shatterpoint HP** left.
abilities.quote: "Throw everything you've got at me, I've got nothing to lose." - Jane

abilities.name: CRYSTAL PITCH
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe throws a jar containing an explosive crystal that detonates on impact with a Killer, Survivor, or any surface, creating an area-of-effect blast. The projectile travels in a slow arc by default, but can be charged for up to 2 seconds to increase its speed and explosion radius. Charging the throw reduces Jane Doe's movement speed by 30%, leaving her more vulnerable while preparing the attack.

**Upon Impact on Survivor/Killer:**

•**Survivor:**
••Grants ⟦Purified|1⟧ for 3 seconds.
••Restores 2 Shatterpoint HP to Jane Doe.
•**Killer:**
••Applies ⟦Resonance|I⟧.
••Restores 3 Shatterpoint HP.
••Reveals Jane Doe's aura to the Killer for 3 seconds.

**Long-Range Bonus:**

•Directly hitting the Killer from 110+ studs applies ⟦Resonance|II⟧.

**⟦Resonance|⟧ Mechanics:**

•Lasts 30 seconds.
•Reapplying refreshes duration and increases the level by 1, up to ⟦Resonance|III⟧.

**Limitations:**

•Cannot apply ⟦Resonance|⟧ if the Killer has been affected by ⟦Resonance|⟧ or ⟦Stunned|⟧ within the last 10 seconds.

**Undocumented:**
•⟦Purified|⟧ grants resistance against attacks depending on how much health is missing from the affected survivor.
••This starts at 20% for every extra 20 HP missing from the affected survivor, and caps at 80% resistance with 80 HP missing.
•⟦Purified|⟧ and ⟦Resistance|⟧ stack additively. For example, 80% damage protection from ⟦Resistance|⟧ combined with 20% from ⟦Purified|⟧ results in 100% damage resistance.
•**Crystal Pitch** still restores Shatterpoint HP when it hits the Killer, even if ⟦Resonance|⟧ is not applied or the timer does not reset.
•**Crystal Pitch** applies the effects of hitting a Survivor to any humanoid that is not the Killer, including Minions or NPCs.

abilities.quote: "The same corruption that had taken over Him, was repurposed by me." - Jane

abilities.name: HATCHET
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe draws her **Hatchet** and prepares a swift attack against the Killer. After a 0.75s windup, she lunges forward and swings her **Hatchet** in a top-down diagonal arc from right to left, briefly gaining ⟦Resistance|1⟧ during the attack. If the strike connects, the target takes **25** damage **(10 damage if the target is John Doe)** and its effects vary depending on the Killer's ⟦Resonance|⟧ level.

**Base Hit (No ⟦Resonance|⟧):**

•Applies ⟦Helpless|1⟧ and ⟦Slowness|2⟧ for 2 seconds.
•Restores 5 Shatterpoint HP to Jane Doe.

**⟦Resonance|⟧ Scaling:**

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|1⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 10 Shatterpoint HP.

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|2⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 3.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 15 Shatterpoint HP.

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|3⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 4.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 20 Shatterpoint HP.

**Additional Notes:**

•Each ⟦Resonance|⟧ level increases the stun duration.
•The extra stun time begins at 1 second but is reduced by 30% for every Jane Doe currently alive.

**Undocumented:**

•**Hatchet** still restores Shatterpoint HP on hit, but does not restore if the Killer is already ⟦Stunned|⟧ or if the strike itself fails to stun.
•Level 0 **Hatchet** works even if the Killer has stun immunity.
•**Hatchet**'s hitbox only hits one target.

abilities.name: SPAWN PROTECTION

Dusekkar projects a protective barrier onto an ally, shielding them from harm at a distance.

The shield can be maintained for up to 3.5 seconds within a range of 95 studs. While active, the target gains ⟦Resistance|IV⟧, while Dusekkar is slowed by 30% during channeling.

**Channeling Mechanics:**

•The cursor must remain fixed on the target to sustain the shield.
•If line of sight is broken for more than 2 seconds, the shield collapses.

**Lethal Protection:**

•If the target would take lethal damage, the hit is completely negated.
•The shield immediately breaks upon preventing death.
•An XP popup appears explaining the interaction.

**Restrictions:**

•Cannot target anchored players, executing players, or another Dusekkar currently channeling protection.
•Failed casts do not trigger cooldown.
•Protected players cannot be targeted again for 30 seconds.

**Stacking Penalties**

•If three or more Dusekkars are shielding simultaneously, all shields shatter.
•All involved Dusekkars receive ⟦Blindness|III⟧ and ⟦Slowness|III⟧ for 6 seconds.

**Undocumented:**

•Uses cursor targeting rather than visibility, allowing usage through walls.
•Can mitigate grab-based attacks if applied before anchoring occurs.
•Negating lethal damage does not grant the on-hit speed boost.
•⟦Resistance|IV⟧ has a short wind-up, but death prevention is instant.
•After **Spawn Protection** ends, there is a very brief timeframe where the ⟦Resistance|IV⟧ will linger.
•The -30% Movement Speed effect behaves as an invisible ⟦Slowness|III⟧, dispelling weaker ⟦Slowness|⟧ Effects.

After a 2-second windup, the beam fires up to 75 studs. During casting, Dusekkar's movement speed is reduced by 25%.

characters.lead: Taph is a FORSAKEN-original support Survivor, available for 600 Player Points. A demolition, trap, and stealth survivor, they make use of two tools: a tripwire and the Subspace Tripmine. The tripwire activates when crossed, slowing the Killer's speed and revealing their aura. characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/taph-title.webp

abilities.name: TRIPWIRE
abilities.desc:
Taph places a tripwire on the ground to hinder the Killer and alert nearby Survivors. Each Taph may have up to 3 tripwires active at a time; placing a fourth will automatically remove the oldest one, similar to John Doe's Digital Footprint.

When the Killer triggers a tripwire:
•All Survivors, including Taph see the Killer's aura for 8 seconds.
•The Killer is inflicted with ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 4 seconds.

Additional info:
•Tripwires have 10 health and are destroyed if struck by the Killer.
•Has a 1.5s arming time.
•After placement, they gradually become less visible over 150 seconds.
•Each tripwire lasts forever.
•Stakes cannot be placed within 8 studs of one another.
•For every other Taph currently alive, negative effects inflicted by Tripwire will be shortened by 1.5s.

**Undocumented:**
•
•**Subspace Tripmines** obstruct the tripwire's placement point, though this does not happen when done the other way around.
•Taph's traps are highlighted to Survivors who are near them until they get completely destroyed.
•Taph's traps are destroyed upon death.

abilities.name: SUBSPACE TRIPMINE
abilities.desc:
Taph arms a Subspace Tripmine and throws it onto the ground. Once placed, the mine becomes semi-invisible, briefly revealing itself every 13 seconds with a faint purple glow and sound cue.

When a Killer enters within 19 studs, the mine triggers after 0.5 seconds, inflicting ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 3 seconds and ⟦Subspaced|III⟧ and ⟦Weakness|V⟧ for 6 seconds, which applies a dark pinkish visual filter and forcibly redirects the killer's camera for 6 seconds. If Taph is within the blast radius, they are also afflicted with the Tripmine's debuffs.

The Subspace Tripmine can be prematurely detonated if struck by a Killer's attack:

•If destroyed before activation, it inflicts a weaker ⟦Subspaced|I⟧ with no ⟦Helpless|I⟧ or ⟦Weakness|V⟧.
•If left untouched for 50 seconds, it automatically explodes.
•If the mine successfully detonates on a Killer, its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
•For every other Taph currently alive, negative effects inflicted by Subspace Tripmine will be shortened by 2s.

**Undocumented:**
•If a **Subspace Tripmine** detonates during a kill animation, and the killer is caught in its blast radius, they will still be inflicted with ⟦Subspaced|3⟧, but without ⟦Helpless|⟧. However, if this happens to Taph, they will still be inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧.
•⟦Subspaced|⟧'s high contrast effect become darker instead of brighter if epilepsy mode is enabled. Additionally, it silences the killer's chase theme to those inflicted by it.
•Taph's traps are highlighted to survivors who are near them until they get completely destroyed.
•Taph's traps are destroyed upon death.

characters.lead: Guest 666 is a **Snowball/Attrition** Killer who excels at punishing mistakes, applying constant pressure, and using precision over brute force. This final phase applies ⟦Hemorrhage|I⟧, lasting up to 120 seconds (removable by another Survivor), gradually reducing the target's maximum HP. Success with **Carving Slash** rewards Blood and cooldown reduction, while missing can briefly slow Guest 666.

•Speed is lost once Guest 666 stops moving toward the highlighted Survivor while outside of 30 studs, exits the 30 stud range while not moving toward them or the highlight runs out.

**Undocumented:**

abilities.desc:
**Hemorrhage**

Many of Guest 666's attacks inflict ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, a status effect that prevents full healing and causes Survivors to drop Blood Orbs. The effects are as follows:
•While afflicted with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, vines begin to cover the Survivor's health bar.
•Any health covered by vines cannot be healed.
•⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ can be removed by another Survivor, but they must interact with you first by clicking.
•Medkits can remove ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, but do not restore vine-covered health.

**Blood Orbs**

Survivors affected by ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ will occasionally drop Blood Orbs, which Guest 666 can collect to empower their abilities. The effects are as follows:
•Each Blood Orb grants Guest 666 15 Blood on contact.
•Blood Orbs drop faster when the Survivor is sprinting and slower during a chase.
••Sprinting: 1 Blood Orb every 10 seconds.
••Chase: 1 Blood Orb every 35 seconds.
••Sprinting in Chase: 1 Blood Orb every 25 seconds.
•Guest 666 starts with 0 Blood and has a maximum of 200 Blood.
•Collecting Blood Orbs reduces all active cooldowns by 3 seconds per orb.
•Killing a Survivor grants 30 Blood. If the kill was caused by **Demonic Pursuit**, it grants 50 Blood instead.
•Blood Orbs can always be collected during LMS, regardless of Guest 666's current Blood Meter.

**Combat**

•Guest 666's attacks are devastating and can hit multiple targets at once.
•The effects are as follows:
•All of Guest 666's attacks hit multiple players simultaneously.

abilities.name: DEMONIC PURSUIT
abilities.desc:
**Demonic Pursuit** is a charge- and mobility-based ability. On use, Guest 666 crouches and becomes transparent until the button is released. The ability can be held or toggled to charge longer, which increases damage and speed. A red arrow visualizer appears and can be aimed upward.

**Pinning a Survivor**

If Guest 666 makes contact with a Survivor while airborne or within the first 0.8 seconds of a leap, they will pin them down. When a Survivor is successfully pinned:
•Guest 666 slashes the Survivor 5 times.
•Inflicts 1 stack of ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧
•Throws the Survivor to the left and roars.
••Changing direction mid-leap does not alter the throw direction.

**Damage Values**

Each slash deals damage depending on how long the ability was charged:
•5.2 / 6.6 / 8.0 damage per hit
•Total: 26 / 33 / 40 damage
Successfully landing the ability grants 20 Blood, and killing a Survivor with this ability grants 50 Blood.

**Blood Hunt Bonus**

During Blood Hunt, this ability deals bonus damage based on how long the Survivor has been afflicted with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧.
•Damage increases by +0.4 for every unhealable health point
••At maximum ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ coverage, total damage is 65 / 72 / 79
••(13 / 14.4 / 15.8 per slash)

**Undocumented:**

characters.lead: Nosferatu, or simply Nos, is a FORSAKEN-original Killer and one of the eight playable Killers in FORSAKEN, available for 1,922 Player Points, making him the second most expensive Killer (Being slightly cheaper than Azure). A vampire who focuses on stealth, mobility, and traps, he suppresses his footsteps, transforms into a bat to take flight and perform diving attacks, carves bloody puddles into the ground, throws a chain to hook and reel in his target, and hurls an orb filled with bats to disorient players.

abilities.name: LEVITATION
abilities.desc: Nosferatu levitates naturally, meaning that they don't have footstep sounds. This passive is shared with Dusekkar.
abilities.quote: "To walk without sound is to hunt without mercy." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: LACERATE
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu slashes in front of him with his claws.
•Damage: **24**
•Windup: **0.3s**
•Linger: **0.3s**
•Length: **8.5 studs**
abilities.quote: "We are the things that Robloxians fear." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: BLOODHOOK
abilities.desc:
After a 0.9s windup Nosferatu throws a horizontal chain at a survivor for 15 damage and "reel them in", triggering a brief minigame for the survivor to escape. If they fail the minigame, they receive follow-up damage. The effects are as follows:
•Can hit multiple Survivors, but can only grab one.
•Can be blocked by the environment.
•Has a range of roughly 115 studs.

•**If the projectile hits a survivor at 24 or less studs:**
••Drags the survivor and deals 3 additional damage on the kick (18 total).
••The time-based prompt does not appear.

•**If the projectile hits a survivor from long range:**
••A time-based prompt appears for both the killer and the survivor.
••The survivor gets rapidly pulled towards Nosferatu at a speed of 16 studs.
••Nosferatu can retain the grip by successfully completing an action command. Survivors that fail an action will get pulled closer towards Nosferatu.

•**If** Nosferatu **successfully pulls the survivor in:**
••Deals 25 additional damage (40 total).

•Regardless of the pull type he successfully lands, he is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 2 seconds and ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 1 second.
•**If the Survivor escapes:**
••The Survivor is freed at their current position.
••Nosferatu is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 1 seconds.
•As a Survivor: failing button prompts pulls you closer to the Killer.
•As Nosferatu: failing button prompts make Survivor escape easier.

Achievement(s):
abilities.quote:
"We are those who arrive in the night, stalking our prey
and pulling them from prying eyes." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: CATACLYSM
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu performs a full spin to wind up their invisibility before dashing forward in the direction their model is facing. While dashing, he creates a sharp line on the ground. After about two seconds, Nosferatu is teleported back to the starting point and stomps the ground, triggering an explosion and summoning their bloody puddles. The effects are as follows:
•During the dash, Nosferatu gains ⟦Invisibility|IV⟧
•The explosion deals 10 damage.
•The puddles of blood apply 2 status effects:
••⟦Bleeding|II⟧ for 7.5 seconds, dealing 19(?) damage over time.
••⟦Slowness|I⟧ for 7.5 seconds.
•Any Survivors that step into the puddle's will be highlighted for 7.5 seconds.
•Puddles last 12 seconds before despawning.

Achievement(s):
abilities.quote:
"Dude I swear on my life I saw a vampire dash
 at like mach 5!!!" - Random Robloxian

abilities.name: HUNTER'S FEAST
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu unleashes an orb of bats after a 0.23s windup, moving toward the direction of the player's cursor. The orb can be redirected once by pressing the ability button again, giving it omni-directional control, but it cannot be redirected more than once and it cannot pass through walls. The effects are as follows:
•Deals 5 damage.
•Applies ⟦Oblivious|⟧ and ⟦Creatures|⟧ for 10 seconds.
•Highlights the survivor for 10 seconds
• If the projectile does not collide with a surface or a Survivor, it persists for 10s before despawning.

•Nosferatu**'s buffs upon hitting a survivor:**
••Gains ⟦Invisibility|V⟧ and ⟦Undetectable|⟧ for 10 seconds.
••Using any ability, including Lacerate, removes these effects.

•**Cooldown behavior:**
••The normal cooldown begins only after the projectile hits a surface or a Survivor.
••If it despawns naturally after its lifespan, the cooldown begins at despawn.
•• Redirecting the projectile starts the cooldown immediately, even if no collision has occurred.

**Undocumented:**

•Redirecting the projectile also makes it travel 4 times faster.
•After casting, there is a brief window where the projectile cannot yet be redirected.
abilities.quote:
"THE BATS AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
 - Unfortunate Robloxian

abilities.name: ASCENSION
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu leaps upward and briefly transforms into a bat, gaining flight for up to 10 seconds. The effects are as follows:

•Pressing the spacebar flaps his wings to gain height.
•Holding the spacebar allows him to hover briefly and slows his descent. Nosferatu will only continue hovering if he flaps in-between glides.
If the 10 seconds of flight are up, Nosferatu will revert back to his normal state and gain ⟦Helpless|⟧ and ⟦Slowness|III⟧ for 4s.

Nosferatu can perform a dive attack while in bat form by using the Primary Attack.

After pressing Lacerate, Nosferatu, after a 0.6 second windup, will begin to dive downwards at an angle towards their camera's direction. Upon hitting a survivor, they will instantly revert to their original humanoid form, pin down the target, and bite them for 5 damage. Afterwards, they will perform a spinning toss that deals additional damage. This damage rapidly scales with how long you spent diving, from a base 5 damage, up to 0.55s of diving time and 30 damage maximum. (10-35 total).

If the dive attack is missed, Nosferatu takes 20 self-damage and is inflicted with ⟦Slowness|III⟧ and ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 3 seconds.

**Undocumented:**

• Nosferatu has complete invincibility during **Ascension**, meaning he cannot get ⟦Stunned|⟧ or hit by any offense ability.
• Stamina will immediately begin regenerating regardless of how Nosferatu exits Ascension.
• While in his bat-form, Nosferatu has all survivors highlighted to him.
• On mobile, Nosferatu gains height by pressing and holding the sprint button.
abilities.quote:
"You know what's in here, I know what's in here.
 Inside you'll find..." -???

abilities.name: DISMOUNT
abilities.desc:
By re-using Ascension anytime during its duration, you will automatically return to your default form.

If Nosferatu exits without using the dive attack, he will be inflicted with ⟦Slowness|III⟧ and ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 4 seconds.

The Golem gains a **10% movement speed boost** while more than **85 studs** away from any Survivor.
The Golem reduces all incoming negative status effects by 50% and can not be stunned.

If the Golem is hit by a stun, it will instead receive 3s of ⟦Slowness|II⟧ and ⟦Helpless|⟧.

abilities.desc:
After a 0.7s windup, the Golem will slam the ground under it and produce a shockwave that knocks over hit survivors briefly and deals damage based on how close they are to the center of the shockwave, up to 35 damage.

abilities.desc:
After a 0.8s windup, the Golem will stomp the ground and send a shockwave forwards that will knock back hit survivors and deal 15 damage.

As the shockwave travels, it will leave behind a fissure in its wake. This fissure slows survivors by 70% while they are inside of it. The fissure lasts for 8s.

Survivors are able to be carried by the shockwave as it travels, but will not take more than one instance of damage.

characters.description: The remains of a withered spirit controlled by the hands of others. Azure springs new life to shutdown and control the survivors movement. When at their zenith, Azure summons an overwhelming construct to cull any in his path.
characters.lead: Azure, full name Azurewrath, and real name Aspen, is the 8th Killer to be added to FORSAKEN and currently the most expensive Killer, costing **$2,000**. He is a FORSAKEN-original Killer. He was heavily hinted to be the next Killer when he appeared at the end of the Forsaken Roadmap Showcase on the official Forsaken YouTube channel, where a likely update icon of them was shown connected via an arrow to Jane Doe's release update. Based on their moveset, Azure is a Trapper Killer, making them the second Trapper Killer alongside John Doe.

abilities.name: ECHOLOCATION
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants are triggered by sound. If survivors sprint or use an ability near them, they will trigger and attack the survivor.

Survivors that trigger plants have their aura revealed to Azure for 3s.
abilities.quote: "The transient sounds of winds sound softer today." -Aspen

abilities.name: ATROPIC
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants apply a unique status effect named ⟦Atropa|⟧. This status effect is the primary way to gain OBLATION. OBLATION is also gained through dealing damage.

Azure gains 1 OBLATION for every stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on a survivor when hit with Perforating. If Atropa expires naturally, Azure gains 1 OBLATION for every 2 stacks of Atropa, with a minimum of 1 OBLATION gained.

Additionally, Perforating and Pummeling will deal 1 additional damage for every stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on a survivor when hit. However, this will also remove all Atropa stacks.

⟦Atropa|⟧ highlights survivors affected by it to Azure, with the highlight growing darker the more stacks they have.

Seeker Bulb's inflict 1 stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit, Stigmatize Vine's inflict 3 stacks of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit, and a survivor fully disarming either of them is inflicted with 2 stacks of ⟦Atropa|⟧.

⟦Atropa|⟧ can not go beyond 6 stacks, and additional stacks do not refresh the existing status timer.

Azure can have a maximum of 15 OBLATION.
abilities.quote: "May nature's hands be kinder than the folly of man.." -Aspen

abilities.name: SENESCENCE
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants are able to be temporarily disarmed by survivors.

However, Azure's Seeker Bulb's and Stigmatize Vine's begin life Blooming. Blooming plants are glowing, unable to be disarmed, and have certain traits amplified.

Seeker Bulb's will fire faster while Blooming, and Stigmatize Vine's windup is significantly faster and attack cooldown is reduced while Blooming.

if either plant is disarmed, they will enter a withered state and become inactive for 30s.

However, once a plant becomes active again, they will begin Blooming once more.

The Blooming state lasts for 40s.

**Undocumented:**
•While Blooming, Seeker Bulbs' exact firerate increase is 1.33x.
•Disabling a Seeker Bulb or Stigmatize Vine will give the Survivor two stacks of Atropa.
abilities.quote: "Sometimes I dream of him being plagued by illness. Freed from them." -Aspen

Azure jabs his tentacles forward.
This will additionally trigger any nearby plants on hit.
abilities.quote: "May your faith remain unshaken, and your strength never yield." -Elder Amarah

abilities.name: SEEKER BULB
abilities.desc:
Azure will slow down and then after a 0.86s windup will jab a tentacle forward, spawning a Seeker Bulb on the hit surface.

Upon being triggered, they will begin to fire projectiles at the survivor who activated it, dealing 4 damage and applying a stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit.

Seeker Bulbs will stop firing after 1.5s if they lose line of sight of survivors or survivors stop making noise near it.

Azure can have up to 3 Seeker Bulbs at once. Using the ability again with 3 Seeker Bulbs placed will replace the oldest one.

**Undocumented:**
•It shoots in a **30 studs ** radius.
abilities.quote: "Certain types of nightshade can be fatal, so be careful..." -Aspen

abilities.name: STIGMATIZE
abilities.desc:
Azure will briefly come to a near standstill and then after a 0.8s windup will summon a Vine.

Vines have a brief 1.2s arm time after they are finished being summoned.

Upon being triggered, they will track and attempt to attack the nearest survivor to trap them. The attack has a 0.6s windup.

If the attack hits a survivor, they will take 14 damage and become snared and unable to move more than a small distance away from the Vine before being pulled back in.

Survivors are released from the snare after 5s of being trapped or they take more than 10 damage.

Upon being released, survivors gain ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 1s.

After releasing a survivor or missing an attack, the Vine will briefly wither and go on a 6.5s cooldown before being able to be triggered again.

**Undocumented:**

•Trapped Survivors are still able to use their abilities.
•It can reach up to **20 studs** in a radius.
abilities.quote: "Perhaps we could ask if we could handle these overgrowths ourselves?" -Two Time

abilities.name: ENSTRANGLE
abilities.desc:
Azure becomes unable to sprint and winds up a tentacle for 1s, after which Azure can press the Perforating ability button to send a tentacle towards the targeted location.

Azure is able to cancel the ability by pressing the button again, which will set it on a shortened cooldown.

Upon hitting a survivor, they will take 10 damage and Azure will regain the ability to sprint while grabbing them and holding the caught survivor for a bit before throwing them towards the targeted location. Azure can press the Perforating ability button again to throw the held survivor early.

The thrown survivor takes 5 damage and is briefly knocked down on impact. Survivors within a 20 stud radius of the impact point are also briefly knocked down.

Azure is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 2s upon throwing the survivor. If the survivor is thrown too close to Azure, the duration of the ⟦Helpless|⟧ is increased and Azure will additionally suffer ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 2s.

While using this ability Azure has their Stamina Regeneration reduced by 75%.

Thrown survivors will always trigger any nearby plants upon landing.

**Undocumented: **

•Enstrangle grab cutscene grants Invincibility to Azure. Invincibility lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after the initial grab animation ends.
abilities.quote: "Holding your hand like this... makes me not want to let go.." -Two Time

abilities.name: INFLORESCENCE
abilities.desc:
Once Azure reaches 15 OBLATION, they are able to summon the Golem.

Summoning the Golem takes 4.8s. After the Golem has finished summoning, they are able to be freely controlled by Azure by pressing the ability button again. The Golem becomes a statue when not being controlled.

The Golem has a maximum lifetime of 45s, and the lifetime is paused while not being controlled.
Swapping to and from the Golem has a cooldown of 2.5s.

Azure is unable to gain OBLATION while the Golem exists.
abilities.quote: "Rise, once more, Azurewrath."

effects.atropa: A stacking debuff (up to Atropa VI) which reveals the Survivor's aura to Azure (color ranges from pink to dark purple based on their Atropa stack) and increases the damage of Perforating (and Pummeling) by 1 for each stack of Atropa If a Survivor with Atropa gets hit by Perforating, Azure will gain Oblation based on their Atropa stack, but also completely removes Atropa from the Survivor
effects.exhausted: Reduces stamina regeneration and increases stamina drain by 10% per stack. The stamina bar turns red while Exhausted is active.
effects.bleeding: Bleed does 2 damage per second of the duration, except for the final second (eg: for 5 seconds of Bleeding, it'll do damage 4 times, so a total of 8 damage). Increasing stacks will do more damage more frequently until Bleeding V, where any higher stacks will do the same DPS. It caps out at 10 HP, and won't deal any further damage.
effects.blindness: Each stack makes your screen blurrier. Blindness I (1) makes your screen 20% more blurry, capping at Blindness III (3) at 60% blurriness.
effects.burning: Deals damage over time and sets the target ablaze, dealing 0.95 damage every 0.5 seconds (1.9/s). Each stack (from I to V) has a dps of 1.9/s, 2.5/s, 3.3/s, 4.3/s, and 6.2/s respectively, and all other stacks will do 6.2/s as well. This status effect has the ability to kill players, unlike other effects leaving them at 1 or 10 hp. However, damage can be nullified with Resistance applied.
effects.corrupted: Deals damage over time and makes red numbers 1 and 0 appear and disappear around the target. (if killer is using Abberant, the 1's and 0's are replaced with geometric faces due to Abberant's custom corruption) Each attack increases the frequency and quantity of damage. This status effect cannot kill players. The base rate of damage is 1.9/s for one stack, 2.5/s for two stacks. The increment of DPS averages at around +35% and stops at five stacks (6.2/s), with additional stacks doing nothing more.
effects.glitched: Glitches the target's Health and Stamina bars, rendering you unable to see most of the UI. Each stack of Glitched amplifies this effect, stacking up to Glitched III. If the target has the setting Center Stamina Counter enabled, Glitched removes the stamina counter beneath your crosshair.
effects.helpless: The target is unable to use their abilities for the duration of the effect. Ability icons are covered with a chain and padlock.
effects.hallucination: Hallucinations last 20 seconds before disappearing, when they disappear a placeholder image of Noli will spawn in the middle of your screen, obscuring your vision. Noli is also alerted of your position via purple highlights, with the highlights becoming darker the higher Hallucination a survivor has. Hallucination picks random hallucinations from a pool, the amount varies depending on the stacks of Hallucination (1 Hallucination at one stack, 2 at two stacks, and 3 at three.), these being: - The timer displaying the wrong time, consistently. - The wrong amount of Generators completed. - Layer 1/2 of Noli's Chase Theme starts to play constantly. - A fake Pizza from Elliot's Pizza Throw spawns, only if an Elliot is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) - A fake Dispenser from Builderman's Dispenser spawns, only if a Builderman is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) - A fake Shield from Dusekkar, only if a Dusekkar is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) A fake Noli clone will always spawn once Hallucination 3 is hit, the clone will walk roughly towards you. It plays Noli's chase theme at the right distance, and will almost always sprint towards you when you're immediately in its line of sight. Noli will be entirely visible during the effect. You can tell the clone apart from Noli because it is only able to perform M1s and occasionally use / bait out Void Rush, and the M1s do 15 damage instead of 25. The fake Pizza and Dispensers from Hallucination 2+ appear to heal you, but the healing is reverted after the Hallucination ends, similar to the fake Noli.
effects.hemorrhage: Lowers your Maximum HP, but not your current HP, represented as a stripped black bar on your healthbar. Increases the frequency and amount of maximum health reduced per stack. Hemorrhage can be healed via a Medkit. If Max HP is lower than HP, no HP is recovered, else, only heal up to current Max HP. Clicking on another survivor will request aid, allowing them to perform a 6 second healing interaction to remove Hemorrhage. Progress is kept if healing is cancelled. Maximum HP is returned overtime once Hemorrhage wears off. This also affects some of Guest 666's abilities, such as Guest 666's Demonic Pursuit (while Blood Hunt is active) dealing more damage the more your max health is reduced.
effects.insanity: Levels 1-4 of Insanity turns your screen fully red. For some reason, after level 4, the screen turns black instead.
effects.nausea: Disorientates your screen. Every level of this status increases the effect.
effects.oblivious: Makes you unable to hear the terror radius of killers.
effects.poisoned: Deals damage over time, and tints the target a sickly green/makes certain parts of their body a sickly green. Each stack increases the intensity, speed, and quantity of the damage. This status effect cannot kill players, although it used to.
effects.slowness: Slows down your movement speed. Every level of this status lowers speed by 10%.
effects.confused: Inverts your controls. Effect worsens with each stack.
effects.stunned: Makes the target unable to move or use any abilities for the duration of the effect, and cancels the target's abilities if they were stunned during the windup. Stunned cannot be applied again while already being stunned and a short duration after the stun.
effects.subspaced: When applied, your screen is filled with a pink tint and blur (Level 1+), darkens your screen (Level 2+), and quickly turns your camera in a random horizontal direction (Level 3+). Every level of this status intensifies the effect, and increases duration; capping at subspaced X(?). Additionally, any aura read currently active is canceled. This effect has the ability to silence the killer's chase theme. (Note: This effect cannot be reapplied while it is active.)
effects.vulnerable: Receive 20% more damage per stack. You can calculate the total damage by using 0.2x\cdot(5+y), where x is damage and y is the amount of stacks. (or just multiply by.2 for every stack of Vulnerable)
effects.weakness: When applied, the target deals 10% less damage per stack. Vulnerable and Weakness used to be one and the same, but were later separated into their own effects.
effects.gouged: UPCOMING: was revealed in a discord stage. When a survivor is initially (GOUGED), Slasher gains an aura read for 5s. Only layer 1 of the chase theme will play while (GOUGED) (GOUGED) can be removed by standing still and holding an interact button. This has been rendered mostly obsolete due to the Oblivious status effect.
effects.hacked: Freezes all ability cooldowns, excluding your main Attack. Abilities already off cooldown will remain usable.
effects.fatigue: Slows down recharge rates of abilities by 20% per stack, and completely freezes ability cooldowns at 10 stacks (Fatigue X)
effects.invisibility: Makes you translucent, and mutes your footsteps. Every level of this status makes you 25% more transparent. Invisibility IV (4) does not follow this formula, making you 92.5% transparency while Invisibility V (5) makes you almost completely invisible, this means that Invisibility will never truly make you fully invisible.
effects.regeneration: Passively heals the target by 5 HP (increased for each stack). A green vignette appears on the target's screen alongside green crosses.
effects.resistance: Reduces damage by 20% per stack. Each stack of Vulnerable will pierce 1 stack of Resistance. This status effect also nullifies Burning damage. Resistance V (5) and above will mute all damage entirely.
effects.speed: Increases movement speed by 10% per stack, while also increasing your screen's field of view. Each stack of Slowness will pierce 1 stack of Speed.
effects.strength: Increases the amount of damage you deal to others. Each level increases damage dealt by 20%.
effects.undetectable: Makes detection methods (such as minions and aura reading abilities) ignore you. This also silences the chase theme when being chased by an undetectable killer as a survivor, or when chasing an undetectable survivor as the killer. The killer can still drain stamina when they are 85 studs away from an undetectable survivor.
effects.purified: Grants one-hit resistance against incoming damage. Damage reduction depends on how much health you have missing already. (+20% resistance per 20HP missing, up to 80%)
effects.haste: Speeds up the recharge rate of all abilities. Speeds up the recharge rate of all abilities by 20% per stack.
effects.slateskin: The target gains 40 overheal per stack and slows the user down by 45%. Gain immunity to Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Corrupted (as of the Nosferatu update), Regeneration, Speed, Hemorrhage (if applied after slateskin) and Weakness.
effects.overheal: Makes the target temporarily have more health. Overheal may behave differently depending on the source. Some effects (such as Dusekkar's Plasma Beam and Noob's Slateskin Potion) cause the extra HP to decay at a rate of 1 HP per 0.5s. However, Noob's Slateskin overheal ends immediately when its duration expires, while Dusekkar's persists until it naturally depletes if uninterrupted. In contrast, Jane Doe's Shatterpoint HP and Guest 1337's Overheal upon blocking a Basic Attack does not decay over time and can only be removed by taking sufficient damage from the Killer or map hazards. This status effect can only be applied through abilities.
effects.marked: Reveals your aura to the Killer with a red outline as opposed to the usual yellow. This bypasses the Undetectable status effect, bypassing the immunity to aura reading, but can be cleansed through gaining Undetectable while having Marked, effectively cancelling the aura reveal.
effects.resonance: Each stack increases the stun duration of Jane Doe's Hatchet, beginning with a 2.25-second stun at Resonance I, 3.25-second stun at Resonance II, and a 4.25-second stun at Resonance III. The total stun time is reduced by 30% for every Jane Doe currently alive in the match. All Jane Does share Resonance; if one Jane Doe applies Resonance to the Killer, your Hatchet will level up accordingly. Resonance immediately ends when a Jane Doe stuns the Killer, regardless of the remaining duration.
effects.stun immunity: This status is applied right when the target is stunned. Three spawn symbols orbit the target as the status is active. Lasts for 10s initially, but lasts longer for each Sentinel currently alive.
effects.invincibility: The target becomes immune to any offensive ability, as well as any negative status effects. (excluding Builderman's Sentry)
effects.imprisoned: When a survivor is afflicted with Imprisoned, small puddles of black will occasionally appear around them in a small stud radius. When these puddles appear, survivors will have a short time to react before chains shoot out of these puddles and towards the position of where the survivor was when the puddle appeared. If the survivor is hit by the chain, they will become ensnared. Survivors will slowly lose ticks of health and they will have to spam a button to fill an escape bar. Once the bar is free, they escape the chain, and the puddle disappears. Every stack of this status effect increases the number of puddles that appear.
effects.disoriented: Disoriented I: Any survivors outside a 25 stud radius will have their appearance concealed to the affected survivor. Disoriented II: Distorted faces and images will flash on the affected survivor’s screen, accompanied by glitchy droning ambience which drowns out other audio. Disoriented III: Screen becomes dark and highly saturated, limiting vision immensely. Like Hallucination, this status effect is hidden.

elliot.note: Very easily picked off and targeted in lower skill lobbies without anyone to protect them.

dusekkar.note: Very easily picked off and targeted in lower skill lobbies without anyone to protect them.

helperbot.note: Very easily picked off and targeted in lower skill lobbies without anyone to protect them.

builderman.note: Very easily picked off and targeted in lower skill lobbies without anyone to protect them.

taph.note: Very easily picked off and targeted in lower skill lobbies without anyone to protect them.

two-time.note: Terrible when it comes to 1v1 scenarios with lower skill players, as they are usually unable to hit Matador backstabs consistently in chase, and Two Time excels at stunning the Killer while they chase another Survivor, not themselves.

chance.note: Only gets one stun per chase, as they gain Weakness for trying to unlock their ability.

slasher.about: Slasher excels at picking people off one by one, so having a team constructed of 2 Healers, 2 Supports, 1 Survivalist and 3 Sentinels is usually best against him.
slasher.tip: Helperbot and Elliot need to cycle between their healing abilities unless no one is injured. Helperbot will rarely get the chance to use Inspire, so its AOE healing is its main ability here. Shedletsky should stun whenever he gets the chance, while Guest 1337 only stuns when the Killer is close enough, and Jane Doe only at 3 stacks. Veeronica should always be cranking generators to cut down the time and build up her battery in case she needs to survive Last Man Standing.

c00lkidd.about: c00lkidd is similar to Slasher, but he can easily multi-hit with his heavy-hitting abilities. A team constructed of 2 Healers, 3 Supports and 3 Sentinels is usually best against him.

Support.note: Taph and Builderman are both strong against c00lkidd.

c00lkidd.tip: Play it the same as against Slasher, but Taph or Builderman should always have a Sentry or a Subspace Tripmine and Tripwire nest set up. The Helpless from Subspace Tripmine and the time wasted destroying well-placed Sentries can be detrimental to the Killer.

1x1x1x1.about: 1x1x1x1 is countered by 3 specific Survivors: Two Time, Shedletsky and Dusekkar. The best team comp against them is 1 Healer, 3 Supports, 1 Survivalist and 3 Sentinels.
1x1x1x1.tip: Whenever 1x1x1x1 uses Mass Infection, Two Time and Shedletsky can stun them out of it, while Jane Doe builds up her stacks. Jane should only stun at 3 stacks unless the situation is dire.

noli.about: Noli is countered mainly by Survivalists, so the best team comp against him is 2 Healers, 1 Support, 3 Survivalists and 2 Sentinels.
noli.tip: Jane Doe plays a little differently in this team. She needs to juggle building up stacks and applying Purified to people, with Dusekkar applying Resistance. If she has any stack at all on the Killer, she should stun.

guest-666.about: Guest 666 is heavily hindered by Supports. Because of her Anti Heal, Healers are less efficient against her. The best team comp against her is 1 Healer, 3 Supports, 1 Survivalist and 3 Sentinels.
guest-666.tip: Guest 666's large hitbox makes Taph very potent against her, and makes it easier for Two Time to land backstabs. That lets Two Time stun the Killer consistently if they stay out of chase, and improves their own survivability.

john-doe.about: John Doe is strong because he can turn the map against the Survivors and counter their stuns, so he can focus someone out very easily even against a strong team. He needs a more balanced team to counteract him: 2 Healers, 2 Supports, 2 Survivalists and 2 Sentinels.

Survivalist.note: 007n7 and Veeronica are both good here; it comes down to personal choice.

john-doe.tip: Dusekkar is very important for this team: any time John Doe is stunned, Dusekkar beams him to cancel his Unstoppable passive. With two Dusekkars up, Unstoppable becomes useless no matter what.

nosferatu.about: Nosferatu is hurt by tanky characters that can mitigate his abilities. His best team comp is 2 Healers, 1 Support, 3 Survivalists and 2 Sentinels.
nosferatu.tip: Always keep one Guest 1337 with the main clump of the team and the other one away, ready to jump in at any time without constantly being in harm's way. When one gets low, swap them around and heal the injured one. The Noobs and 007n7 can tank Nosferatu's hits for themselves or other Survivors by body blocking with Slateskin Potion or Clone.

azure.about: Azure's greatest weakness is characters with Undetectable in their kit, which lets them walk through his traps unharmed. His best team comp is 2 Healers, 1 Support, 4 Survivalists and 1 Sentinel.
tip: Two Time can easily stun Azure out of his grab with their dash stab, forcing him out of aiming it or making him drop whoever he is carrying.

Noob and 007n7 can walk through his traps with Undetectable while the Healers and Supports keep them alive. Because of Azure's sheer damage potential, your most skilled players should be on Support and Healer, as this team is short on Sentinels.

strats.name: Dynamic Stamina
strats.text: Stop sprinting before the gray bar takes over your current stamina to regain stamina faster.

strats.name: Stutter Step
strats.text: Use 10-30 stamina when the Killer/Survivor is far/close enough, then walk until you regain it, or until the Killer/Survivor is far/close enough to (not) hit.

counters.text: Bloxy Cola, if drunk before the chase

strats.name: Body Block
strats.text: When you're high on HP or the round is nearly over, use yourself to body block and stop another Survivor from dying.

strats.name: Aggro
strats.text: Get the Killer's attention so a Survivor on low HP doesn't die.

strats.name: Chill Survivor
strats.text: Miss a stun on purpose or emote near the Killer to make them chill and waste time.

strats.name: 2 Hits
strats.text: Any Survivor can trade health for speed. The extra speed lets you put distance between you and the Killer, forcing them to use more stamina while you build stamina back before getting hit. Best used at max HP, or when the Killer can't 2-shot you.

strats.name: Ability Usage Mid Chase
strats.text: Any Survivor who can use abilities mid chase can help the team, or themselves in Last Man Standing. Best used when the ability can stun the Killer to create distance.

strats.name: Spotting Noli's Fake Generators
strats.text: Complete 1/5 of a fake generator, or leave it empty, so the others know which one is fake. On a real one, complete 2-3/5 and let the others (preferably Elliot) finish it.

strats.name: Generator Hopping
strats.text: Complete at least 2/5 of a generator while your cooldowns are active. Finish it if you're a Survivalist, or if there's an Elliot on the team.

strats.name: Ability Usage Mid Chase
strats.text: Any Killer who can use their unique abilities mid chase can dish out an outburst or chip damage.

counters.text: Any Survivor, if a dash is missed
Bloxy Cola, if drunk before the chase

strats.name: Zoning
strats.text: Survivors can be cornered on some maps, letting you regain stamina and reset the chase to your advantage.

strats.name: Last Man Standing Prep
strats.text: Build up 3 charges for **Reroll** or **One Shot**, then wait for an opening to use **One Shot**. If the Killer has already been stunned or you missed, **Reroll** and repeat until you get ⟦Vulnerable|⟧, a Flintlock Explosion, or a chance to use **Hat Fix** mid chase.

strats.name: HP Threshold
strats.text: Against some Killers it's important to have a set amount of Max HP. This doesn't account for map hazards, Killer dashes, minions, outbursts and traps, ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, Azure combos, ⟦Atropa|⟧, ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ or a Flintlock Explosion.

table.how: 5 M1s and 1 Eviscerate or Blood Hunt cry = 110 damage.
3 M1s with damage over time and 1 Behead, or 1 Raging Pace M1 with damage over time, 2 M1s with damage over time and 1 M1 = 109 damage. This also survives 4 Beheads (100).
3 Entanglements and 3 M1s with damage over time = 114 damage.
2 Corrupt Natures and 3 M1s = 111 damage. This also survives 4 M1s (109).
4 M1s = 112 damage. This also survives 5 Corrupt Energies if hit twice each (110).
Hunter's Feast and 3 M1s while hit with Hunter's Feast, and 1 close-range Bloodhook = 116 damage.

strats.name: Shift Tech
strats.text: When recasting **Void Rush**, hold down Shift. This uses stamina, but HEAVILY increases your speed and leaves Survivors less time to react.

strats.name: Nova Stun
strats.text: Throw **Nova** in the air above your target Survivor. It pulls them into the air and staggers them when they hit the ground, so you can catch up easily.

strats.name: Nova Combo
strats.text: Throw **Nova** at the ground when you're near a Survivor, then M1 for a free 40 damage combo. Riskier but more rewarding: hit them with **Nova**, then slam them for more damage or start a chain. Going for just the slam is the less risky option here.

strats.name: Slide Tech
strats.text: Angle yourself against a structure during **Void Rush** and you'll slide along it. Use this to counter certain loops and structures Survivors use.

strats.name: Noli Airlines
strats.text: Shift Tech off an incline (usually stairs) and Noli is sent flying upwards. Use it to go over structures, or to change the direction of a **Void Rush** when you land.

strats.name: Quiet Nova
strats.text: Use **Nova** to cover your loud ambient noise and breathing and catch people off guard. Noli's breathing is VERY loud and can give your position away.

strats.name: Flying Skins
strats.text: Any skin that flies instead of walking (Milestone 4 and Admin, for example) is quieter, which makes catching people off guard easier.

strats.name: Slide Tech
strats.text: Like Noli, c00lkidd can slide along structures during **Walkspeed Override** if he's angled against them.

strats.name: Slingshot Tech
strats.text: Dash at a Survivor with **Walkspeed Override** and hit them towards your **Pizza Delivery** minions to slingshot them in, for extremely high damage plus ⟦Slowness|⟧.

strats.name: Fake-Outs
strats.text: With no techs that don't hinder him, Shedletsky relies on mindgames: flick your camera back to make the Killer think you're going for the stun, or run at them to sell it. For the best stun in a chase, start the **Slash** swing, then flick at the Killer at the last second to get the most stun time through his endlag.
